info.title: PanelStudio API
info.description: HTTP contract for PanelStudio v0.1. Normative handbook: docs/PanelStudio-spec-v0.1.md. Phase 0 published this contract. Phase 1 implements asset import, panel and label commands, document revisions, SVG and project-package export, and project import. Phase 2 implements the edit kernel: frames, crops, labels, groups, locks, stack order, the remaining document commands, undo, redo, and restart restore. Phase 3 implements automatic layout candidates, candidate reads, preview renders, and accepting a candidate through the transaction path. Phase 5 implements provider settings, the provider test, AI layout jobs, job cancellation, and job event replay. Phase 6 serves the bundled font list and the font zip. Project list, soft-delete, restore, and revision reads are implemented. The response model does not contain provider secrets. All paths are under /api/v1. The service listens on loopback and is deployed same-origin. Authentication, when required, is an external reverse proxy.
